steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: A seventh boss? That's not possible. We've searched every nook and cranny of this map!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Logically, after beating all the enemies, a portal should appear to take us out of here... but we haven't seen one yet.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Perhaps... what we're looking for... is right in front of us?
In this vast, empty world of Project: Dark, only two people remain.
Hecate and Hella exchange a glance.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Can't believe you actually sent me to fight Zoya! Did you want to see me dead?
After a brief silence, the two are entangled in a scuffle.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You were basically having a picnic while I was laser-bombing the MBCC building.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I call that strategic resting! I'm making good use of the DPS stats!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: In that case, let's have a fair friendly match.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: As your friend, I'll give it everything I've got.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But don't you dare tell that dummy about any of this!
